body.brief_text: We are comparing two staffing options, labelled exactly "Keep current staffing" and "Add one specialist". Use the exact goal label "Weekly support capacity". Our existing team resolves 80 tickets per week. Keep current staffing adds no specialist. Add one specialist adds one specialist.
